title: The Lady of the Shroud
author: Bram Stoker
description: "The Lady of the Shroud" by Bram Stoker is a novel published in 1909.
longDescription: Rupert Saint Leger must live a year in his uncle's Balkan castle to inherit a fortune. There he encounters a mysterious woman in a shroud who visits at night, leading him to believe she's a vampire.

authorInfo.bio: Abraham Stoker was an Irish writer, barrister, literary critic, and theatre manager. He was the author of the Gothic horror novel Dracula (1897) and the creator of the fictional character Count Dracula. The work and its antagonist are regarded as milestones in the fields of Gothic and vampire literature.
